msg: Hi, my twin boys are 11 and have their Junior Open Water. I'm not certified and I'd just ride along on the boat. Can they dive with you from Cartagena if I'm not diving? We're from Ireland.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Yes, they can join the certified-diver trip from Cartagena with their Junior Open Water certifications, and you can come along as a non-diving companion. The companion plan includes the round-trip boat, lunch, insurance, and National Natural Park entrance fee.

The online discount is applied automatically when booking.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Yes from Cartagena. So both boys do the 2 dives and I come along on the boat. They last dived in September. Send me the links and tell me the total please.
reply:
Perfect! Both boys can book the certified 2-dive trip with their Junior Open Water certifications, and you can join as a companion. Since they last dived in September, the refresher rule for divers who have been out of the water for more than two years doesn’t apply.

Here are the links:
- **Fun Dives – 2 dives (for each boy):** https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en
- **Companion (for you):** I don’t have a separate online booking link for this plan. The team needs to arrange it, so would you like me to connect you with a team advisor?

I can’t calculate or confirm the booking total here; the booking step will show the exact total.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Come along as a companion: 80 USD · 89 USD

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.
